messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from Friday's outage: cloud control-plane flakiness -> auth timeouts -> model-registry write errors. We need owners and short mitigations.

priya: I'll own auth hardening. Hotfix: local token cache + circuit-breaker. ETA: 36h to staging, 96h to prod. Mid: dual-auth endpoints + health routing. ETA: 4w.

jake: I'll take registry stability. Hot: read-through cache for model metadata (48h). Mid: write-ahead queue + idempotent commits (14d).

megan: Infra tasks: tone down control-plane retries (24h) and author cross-region failover runbook + drill (10d).

sam: Observability: add alerts (auth latency, registry errors) and synthetic write probe every 5m (24h).

alex: Short list this week: priya (token cache), jake (read-cache), megan (retry defaults), sam (probe/alerts). Post PRs/runbook links here. 30m sync Monday 09:30 PT.

ops-bot: Canary started for auth token-cache on staging by @priya at 1766005000.
